process_issues.description: RESTORE_PATHS names `AGENTS.md .agents templates`, but `.claude-pr/` held only `.claude` and `CLAUDE.md`. The head's copies of the restored paths were never snapshotted there. Reviewers read the PR's versions with `git show 2e4078b:<path>` instead, so coverage did not suffer, but the workflow's snapshot step looks like it is not preserving those paths.

Skipped `maintainability` and `context` for this incremental delta (about 79 lines). The only logic change is one `chmod` line plus a new test file, and no spec, protocol or infra surface was touched.
